headline: Pharvaris tightens RAPIDe-3 primary completion date
whatHappened: Pharvaris revised the RAPIDe-3 primary completion date from Q3 2026 to Q2 2026 on ClinicalTrials.gov (illustrative).
whyItMatters: A tighter readout timeline compresses the sebetralstat first-mover window. Confirm via IR channels and update launch-defense scenario plans.

headline: BioCryst Orladeyo pediatric Phase III interim safety update
whatHappened: Favorable safety profile at interim cutoff presented at AAAAI 2026 (illustrative).
whyItMatters: Pediatric oral prophylaxis progression continues on track. No immediate implication for sebetralstat on-demand but tightens pediatric oral landscape for KVD824.

headline: BioCryst Q1 2026 earnings call scheduled
whyItMatters: Expect commentary on Orladeyo growth and competitive positioning. Flag for real-time monitoring.

headline: Pharvaris Q4 2025 cash position: $280M (illustrative)
whatHappened: Runway reported into late 2027, covering readout, filing, and launch prep.
whyItMatters: Reduces financing overhang that might have forced a deal. Makes independent launch scenario more likely.

headline: Takeda Q4 2025 earnings: HAE cited as cornerstone franchise
whatHappened: Management reiterated HAE among top rare disease growth contributors.
whyItMatters: No evidence of divestiture consideration. Expect continued aggressive defense of Takhzyro share.

headline: RAPIDe-3 completes enrollment ahead of schedule
whyItMatters: Removes enrollment risk from readout timeline. Supports confidence in Q3 2026 topline.

headline: BioCryst initiates Phase I for extended-release oral kallikrein inhibitor
whyItMatters: Long-term oral-prophylaxis pipeline continues. Relevant to KVD824 positioning, minimal near-term sebetralstat impact.

headline: EMA updates Takhzyro label to include adolescents 12+
whatHappened: EMA published a Type II variation extending Takhzyro's HAE prophylaxis indication to include adolescents aged 12 and older (illustrative).
whyItMatters: Pediatric reach for Takhzyro widens just as oral entrants approach the adult prophylaxis market. Expect Takeda to lead with pediatric-centred narratives at upcoming congresses.

labelDiff.previous: Indicated for prevention of recurrent HAE attacks in adult patients only.
labelDiff.current: Indicated for prevention of recurrent HAE attacks in adult and adolescent (12+) patients.

headline: EMA grants Orladeyo label update with long-term extension safety data
whatHappened: EMA approved a label variation adding 5-year open-label extension safety and durability data to Orladeyo's prescribing information (illustrative).
whyItMatters: Reinforces oral-modality durability claim. Useful prep ahead of payer renewals and KOL adoption conversations for sebetralstat.

labelDiff.previous: Long-term safety supported by data from open-label extension up to 2 years.
labelDiff.current: Long-term safety supported by data from open-label extension up to 5 years, with sustained attack rate reduction.

headline: Field reps: BioCryst sampling Orladeyo at DACH HAE clinics
whatHappened: Our reps in Germany and Austria logged multiple call reports flagging that BioCryst MSLs are dropping Orladeyo starter kits and patient-support materials at several top-tier HAE clinics over the past 6 weeks (illustrative).
whyItMatters: In-clinic sampling points to a coordinated patient-acquisition push. Brief DACH reps on counter-positioning Ekterly's on-demand convenience versus Orladeyo's daily dosing burden before next call cycle.

headline: Field reps: Takeda offering price concessions in top US HAE accounts
whatHappened: Multiple US reps captured calls indicating Takhzyro contract renewals are being offered with unusual rebate and access concessions in the top-10 HAE prescribing accounts (illustrative).
whyItMatters: Suggests Takeda is buying retention ahead of oral on-demand entry. Map overlapping accounts with Pharma Inc launch targets and prepare counter-engagement materials with payer-tier comparisons.

headline: FDA accepts Andembry sBLA with 12-month real-world safety data
whatHappened: CSL Behring filed a supplemental BLA adding 12-month post-marketing real-world safety data for Andembry (garadacimab). FDA acceptance with PDUFA target Q3 2026 (illustrative).
whyItMatters: Strengthens Andembry's durability narrative in US. Increases switching friction for centers already initiated on injectable prophylaxis ahead of oral entrant launches.

headline: CSL Behring confirms Andembry reimbursement secured in 6 EU markets
whatHappened: CSL Behring reported national pricing agreements for Andembry in Germany, France, UK, Netherlands, Belgium, and Austria (illustrative).
whyItMatters: Broad EU formulary access established before oral entrants. Creates incumbent formulary position in Pharma Inc core markets that will require active displacement.

headline: Ionis initiates quarterly-dosing Phase II extension for Dawnzera
whatHappened: First patients dosed in the ION-449 extended dosing interval study evaluating quarterly SC administration in patients stable on monthly Dawnzera (illustrative).
whyItMatters: Quarterly dosing would close Dawnzera's convenience gap vs oral alternatives. Monitor for PK/PD interim data expected Q4 2026.

headline: Adverum IND-enabling studies on track; IND filing targeted 2027
whatHappened: Adverum confirmed in its Q3 2025 update that IND-enabling studies for the AAV-HAE gene therapy program remain on schedule (illustrative).
whyItMatters: No acceleration of gene therapy timeline. Commercial impact, if any, remains early 2030s — monitoring confirms the long-range horizon holds.

headline: Intellia completes NTLA-2002 Phase II expansion cohort enrollment
whatHappened: Full enrollment of the Phase II expansion cohort for NTLA-2002 (in vivo CRISPR/Cas9 targeting KLKB1) confirmed; Phase III planning discussions with FDA underway (illustrative).
whyItMatters: Accelerating CRISPR timeline in HAE. Phase III initiation expected H2 2026 — watch for KOL excitement that could distract from near-term therapy adoption decisions.

headline: Astria: STAR-0215 meets primary endpoint in ALPHA-STAR Phase II
whatHappened: STAR-0215 (long-acting anti-plasma kallikrein mAb, quarterly dosing) met its primary endpoint of attack rate reduction vs placebo in the ALPHA-STAR Phase II study. Phase III initiation planned Q4 2026 (illustrative).
whyItMatters: Validates long-acting injectable prophylaxis lane. Phase III success adds a quarterly-dosing competitor to the 2028+ prophylaxis market. Minimal near-term impact on sebetralstat on-demand positioning.
